notes.title: ✨🚍 Celebrate Women’s Day with LumiBus ✨🚍
notes.notes:
Hello fellow travelers,

For Women’s Day, I’d love to invite you to try the free demo of LumiBus. It’s a small, cozy game about everyday moments, simple encounters, and the little stories that unfold along the way ✨

If you enjoy slow-paced, slice-of-life experiences, take a ride and see where the journey takes you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187323/557adb0d7131ef498b009d97128366c06e249da1.png[/img]

💖 Experience small stories on the road
✉️ Let us know your thoughts—we’d love to hear from you!

Thanks for being here, and happy Women’s Day!
Anke ~

notes.title: Lumibus Demo Now Available on Steam! ✨
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Lightseekers![/b]
We’re excited to announce that the demo for Lumibus is now live on Steam! As part of the Steam Next Fest, we invite all cozy gamers and puzzle lovers to give it a try. Lumibus is a relaxing, atmospheric puzzle/hidden object game that started as a Game Jam project, and now, we’re thrilled to share it with the Steam community!

[b]🌟 About Lumibus:[/b] Immerse yourself in a calming, beautifully designed world filled with glowing Lampies. Lumibus is perfect for anyone who loves cozy and relaxing games story games.

[b]💪 We need your help![/b] Since this is a demo, your feedback is incredibly important to us. We'd love to hear your thoughts! Please leave a review or comment to help us improve the game.

[b]✅ If you enjoy the experience, don't forget to add Lumibus to your wishlist![/b] By wishlisting the game, you support us in reaching more players and getting better visibility within the community.

🔗 Play the Lumibus Demo now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3247490/Lumibus_Demo/

Thank you so much for your support, and we can't wait to hear your feedback! 💡
Beardshaker Anke ~
